track: clinical insertional-oncogenesis loci vs the integrated safety filter (RB-2)
shipped_score: pen_stack integrated locus score = shipped K562 atlas `writability` + calibrated `safety`, per 1 kb bin (higher writability = safer). Oncogene layer = CancerMine (CC0, >=3 citations); `dist_oncogene` / `genotoxic_cis` from the shipped safety_annot.parquet. Annotation stack = GENCODE v46 + CancerMine (CC0) + DepMap-essential.
corpus: 9 documented clinical insertional-oncogenesis loci from real gene-therapy trials (LMO2, CCND2, MECOM/EVI1, PRDM16, HMGA2, SETBP1, BMI1, MN1) + IKZF1 (Fabry non-persistent, near-oncogene negative-outcome control), versus 8 functionally-validated safe harbors (AAVS1, CLYBL, CCR5, hRosa26, H11, Pansio-1, Olonne-18, Keppel-19)
test_kind: confirmatory face-validity, NOT a novel AUROC. Per the sealed anti-circularity manifest the score rejects annotated oncogenes BY CONSTRUCTION (the CancerMine dist_oncogene / genotoxic_cis layer), so the informative content is the non-obvious subset + the false-negatives + the calibration, not the separation number.

clearest_miss.note: severe, leukaemic in SCID-X1, yet ranks at the 99.9th writability percentile (scored safest) and safety flag passes -> the score's clearest miss

panel.flagged_rule: flagged_by_filter := (safety == 0.0); a locus with safety == 1.0 passes the filter (NOT flagged). Derived from the source `safety` field, cross-checked against RB2_RESULT.md which states SETBP1/BMI1/MN1 'are NOT flagged ... safety 1.0'.

loci.control_note: Fabry non-persistent integration near IKZF1 (<0.15%, did NOT persist) -> not a genotoxic event here; near-oncogene negative-outcome control

companion_axis_discriminability_matched_.note: positive-side (safe-harbour discovery) discriminability of the SAME writability axis versus feature-matched controls, from the blind GSH-discovery run. Context for what the axis CAN discriminate (safe harbours from matched genome) -- it is NOT the genotoxic-panel discrimination and NOT a genotoxicity-prediction number. Cited WITH its bootstrap CI and N per that file's instruction.
companion_axis_discriminability_matched_.tier: all_curated_loci (16 validated+candidate GSH vs matched controls)

honest_characterization: The integrated safety filter cleanly rejects the canonical genotoxic loci it ENCODES (LMO2/CCND2/MECOM/PRDM16/HMGA2, writ_pct <= 2.6, safety 0.0) -- but those five are exactly the genes hard-coded into the score's own genotoxic_cis label, so that separation confirms the filter encodes known-bad loci, it does not predict genotoxicity. On the documented clinical loci OUTSIDE its hard-coded label (SETBP1, BMI1, MN1) the filter produces real false-negatives: writ_pct 34-99.9, safety 1.0, despite documented trial genotoxicity, with severe-leukaemic BMI1 at the 99.9th writability percentile. The oncogene-distance layer registers all three as oncogenes (dist_oncogene = 0) but the integrated writability under-weights that annotation relative to chromatin. Calibration does not track severity (inverted here): the mildest event (benign HMGA2 clonal dominance) scores most extreme (writ_pct 0.0) while the most severe (BMI1 leukaemia) scores safest (99.9). So the component is a coarse reject-known-bad safety filter, not a calibrated genotoxicity predictor; RB-2 sharpens rather than rubber-stamps the manuscript section 3.5 claim.
caveats: Confirmatory face-validity, NOT a novel AUROC. Annotated oncogenes are flagged by construction (CancerMine dist_oncogene layer).
Safe-harbor negatives overlap the section 3.5 validated-GSH set -> not fully independent on the negative side; disclosed.
One representative bin per locus (gene TSS bin / coord bin). Writability is the shipped K562 atlas integrated score.
Gene-level representative bins; per-integration hg38 coordinate extraction for each trial insertion was not performed (TBD-extract per rb_corpus_starter.csv).

reject_known_bad_blocklist.mechanism: any 1 kb bin within 50 kb of a documented clinical insertional-oncogenesis gene is set safety=0.0 by rule, overriding the soft model (pen_stack/wgenome/genotoxic_blocklist.py, applied in atlas load_writability)
reject_known_bad_blocklist.independent_source: 2025 Leukemia review doi:10.1038/s41375-025-02585-8 (independently names all eight) + primary trials (Hacein-Bey-Abina/Howe 2008, Stein 2010/Ott 2006, Cavazzana-Calvo 2010); NOT derived from this benchmark's panel
reject_known_bad_blocklist.framing: completeness fix for a reject-known-bad blocklist, not a prediction claim; a blocklist cannot be validated on its own contents; novel-locus genotoxicity prediction is out of scope (that is the separate BioFirewall CCGD outcome-validated locus axis, AUROC ~0.60)
